title: First piano and lessons from Professor Victor
summary: He started piano about 1929 on a $10 piano, taught himself blues, then took lessons from a school teacher, Professor Victor.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: How old were you when you first started playing the piano?
You were about 14 then, huh? Something like that. Where did you get your first piano? Mother bought a piano for $10. Yeah? Where did you get a piano for $10?
Well, during them times, people were throwing pianos away. Oh, they were? I used to be a two-figure piano player. You just started banging? Yeah, banging by myself. Always could play the blues.
You just started picking it up by yourself? Yeah, picking it by myself. Then how did you meet this Victor where you started taking lessons?
When I went to LaFontaine School. You met him? Yeah. He was a school teacher. He played everything.
Wait, he taught piano or he just played? Yeah, he taught piano, cyzbole, and trumpet. Well, how did you come to decide you were going to take lessons from him?
Well, everybody else was doing something, so I wanted to do something too.
